title: The Ouroboros Thesis v24.1 — Axiom-Free Conditional Uniqueness of the Lutar Invariant: A Machine-Verified Trust Foundation for Governed Agentic AI
description: Version 24.1 of the SZL Holdings Ouroboros thesis program (DOI-pinned lineage v1–v24), an arXiv-style paper on a machine-verified trust substrate for governed agentic AI — the Ouroboros loop, the Lutar invariant Λ, and a proof-trail / receipt architecture formalized in Lean 4. HEADLINE (v24): Lutar.Round13.lambda_unique_of_separable proves conditional Λ-uniqueness under {A1,A2,A3,A5} + slice-multiplicativity (separability) with #print axioms = {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} — no project axiom, kernel-clean, CI-green; this replaces the v23 declared A6′ block-consistency idealization with a checkable property of Φ. ADVANCE (v24.1): CUT-1 — the Aczél quasi-arithmetic representation theorem — is now FULLY CLOSED ON ITS STATED, CHECKABLE HYPOTHESES across Waves 18–22 (forward fragment; Burai–Kiss–Szokol density engine; perfect-set/uncountability residual closed via monotone extension; the (C-order) gap-shift ordering DERIVED rather than assumed — BKS arXiv:2208.07083 eqs 8–9), yielding cut1_sharp_conditional_lambda, which strengthens the conditional Λ-uniqueness chain to be axiom-clean end to end on {A1–A5} + separability + slice-multiplicativity + slice-monotonicity (bisymmetry dropped as redundant, unit-normalization dropped). Current main pinned at ba1050b7 (CI-green, Waves 11–22 merged; ~185 kernel-clean experimental-tier theorems; drift baseline 1323 declarations / 23 axioms (22 unique) / 307 sorries — unchanged). HONESTY DOCTRINE (binding, per SZL Doctrine v11): locked/proven = EXACTLY FIVE {F1,F11,F12,F18,F19} at c7c0ba17 (749/14/163) and nothing else; Λ UNCONDITIONAL uniqueness remains Conjecture 1 and is machine-checked FALSE (maxAgg_ne_Lambda) — CUT-1 strengthens the CONDITIONAL result and does NOT make Λ unconditional; the experimental CI-green tier is separate and never folded into the locked-5; supply-chain posture is SLSA L1 honest with L2 build-attestation present (L2-verified, L3, FedRAMP, Iron Bank, CMMC remain roadmap); Byzantine BFT is Conjecture 2; no fabricated results, no fake citations, 0 runtime CDN. Companion artefact to the lutar-lean Lean 4 formalization.
